title: Platina 100 ES
description: Representing Bajaj Auto's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Bajaj Auto Platina 100 ES is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 100cc powerplant pumps out 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
